passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Some of the information contained in this discussion and analysis or set forth elsewhere in this Annual Report, including information with respect to our plans and strategy for our business, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. You should read the “Risk Factors” section of this Annual Report for a discussion of important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis. 49 Overview IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. IQVIA’s portfolio of solutions are powered by IQVIA Connected Intelligence™ to deliver actionable insights and services built on high-quality health data, Healthcare-grade AI ® , advanced analytics, the latest technologies and extensive domain expertise. We are committed to using artificial intelligence ("AI") responsibly, with AI-powered capabilities built on best-in-class approaches to privacy, regulatory compliance and patient safety, and delivering AI to the high standards of trust, scalability and precision demanded by the industry. With approximately 93,000 employees in over 100 countries, including experts in healthcare, life sciences, data science, technology and operational excellence, IQVIA is dedicated to accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. We are managed through three reportable segments: Technology & Analytics Solutions, Research & Development Solutions and Contract Sales & Medical Solutions. Technology & Analytics Solutions provides mission critical information, technology solutions and real world insights and services to our life science clients. Research & Development Solutions, which primarily serves biopharmaceutical clients, provides outsourced clinical research and clinical trial services. Contract Sales & Medical Solutions provides health care provider (including contract sales) and patient engagement services to both biopharmaceutical clients and the broader healthcare market. Effective January 1, 2026, we will be updating our segment reporting to align with industry evolution, our updated operating model, and how internal reporting will be provided to the chief operating decision maker. As a result, the Contract Sales & Medical Solutions segment, which has become more closely related operationally to the Technology & Analytics Solutions segment commercial offerings, will be incorporated into the Technology & Analytics Solutions segment, which is renamed Commercial Solutions. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: We operate in a rapidly changing environment that involves a number of risks, some of which are beyond our control. You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below together with the other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, in evaluating our Company. The occurrence of any of the following risks may materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects. Summary of Risk Factors Below is a summary of some of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results: Risks Relating to Our Business • The potential loss or delay of contracts could adversely affect our results. • Our financial results may be adversely affected if we underprice our contracts, overrun our cost estimates or fail to receive approval for or experience delays in documenting change orders. • Failure to meet productivity objectives under our internal business transformation initiatives could adversely impact our competitiveness and harm our operating results. • If we are unsuccessful at investing in growth opportunities and are unable to develop and market new services or enter new markets, our growth, results of operations or financial condition could be adversely affected. • If we are unable to successfully identify, acquire and integrate existing businesses, services and technologies, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely impacted. • If we are unable to attract suitable investigators and patients for our clinical trials, our clinical development business might suffer. • If we lose the services of key personnel or are unable to recruit additional qualified personnel, our business could be adversely affected. Intellectual Property • We depend on third parties for data and support services. Our suppliers or providers might restrict our use of or refuse to license data or provide services, which could lead to our inability to access certain data or provide certain services and, as a result, materially and adversely affect our operating results and financial condition. • Our success depends on our ability to protect our intellectual property rights. • We may be subject to claims by others that we are infringing on their intellectual property rights. • We rely on licenses from third parties to certain technology and intellectual property rights for some of our services and the licenses we currently have could terminate or expire. IT systems and Information • Security breaches and unauthorized use of our IT systems and information could expose us, our clients, our data suppliers or others to risk of loss. • We may experience challenges with the acquisition, development, enhancement or deployment of technology necessary for our business. • Data protection, privacy and similar laws restrict access, use and disclosure of personal information, and failure to comply with these laws could materially harm our business. credit_strengths.text: IQVIA's revenue base expanded steadily across the three-year trend, with the latest fiscal year exceeding both prior periods. Operating income held above the earliest year despite a modest dip from the peak, while operating cash flow remained robust and comfortably funded capital expenditure. This scale and cash generation underpin the issuer's ability to service fixed obligations.

Free cash flow after capital expenditure covers a meaningful portion of the debt stack, and the cash balance provides a liquidity cushion. The company's global clinical research and healthcare intelligence franchise generates recurring, contract-backed revenue, which supports the consistency of cash conversion and helps absorb cyclical pressures in life sciences spending.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor passage highlights that potential loss or delay of contracts, underpricing, cost overruns, and failure to obtain change-order approvals could materially harm results. These are concrete earnings risks for a contract research organization with long-duration engagements, where fixed-price or delayed approvals can compress margins and cash flow, weakening debt-service coverage.

Leverage sits well above the sector median, and the debt maturity profile shows meaningful repayments due within the next twelve months and again in year two. Refinancing this ladder in a higher-rate environment could raise interest costs, while the current ratio below one indicates that near-term obligations exceed current assets, requiring external funding or cash-flow reliance.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is thin relative to the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is modest, indicating limited headroom for adverse earnings swings. The indicative financial risk profile is aggressive, with leverage in the fourth tier and cash-flow coverage also in the fourth tier, leaving little cushion before a downgrade threshold is breached.

Operating cash flow covers debt service, but shareholder distributions and acquisitions absorb most free cash flow, constraining deleveraging. The maturity profile requires refinancing within the next twelve months and again in year two, and the cash balance, while positive, is insufficient to fully offset these near-term repayments without new borrowing or asset sales.

overall_credit_view.text: IQVIA's credit profile reflects a leading healthcare intelligence franchise with stable revenue and solid cash generation, but aggressive leverage and thin interest coverage relative to sector peers. The indicative financial risk profile is aggressive, and the Altman Z-score falls in the grey zone, suggesting elevated credit risk without a formal rating implication.

Forward-looking judgement: deleveraging depends on EBITDA growth and disciplined capital allocation, as buybacks and acquisitions currently consume most free cash flow. Refinancing the near-term maturity ladder at higher rates could pressure coverage further. A material contract loss or margin erosion would likely push leverage toward the downgrade threshold, warranting close monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: IQVIA 的營收基礎在三年趨勢中穩步擴大，最近一個財政年度超越先前兩個期間。營業利潤儘管較高峰略有回落，仍高於最早年度，而營運現金流保持強勁，並足以輕鬆支應資本支出。此規模與現金產生能力支撐發行人償付固定義務的能力。
扣除資本支出後之自由現金流覆蓋債務結構的相當部分，而現金餘額提供流動性緩衝。該公司的全球臨床研究與醫療保健情報特許經營業務產生經常性、有合約支持的營收，支持現金轉換的一致性，並有助吸收生命科學支出的週期性壓力。

key_risks.text: 風險因素段落強調，合約可能流失或延遲、定價過低、成本超支，以及未能取得變更訂單批准，可能對業績造成重大損害。對於擁有長期限合約的合約研究組織而言，這些是具體的盈利風險，其中固定價格或延遲批准可能壓縮利潤率與現金流，削弱償債覆蓋能力。
槓桿率遠高於行業中位數，而債務到期結構顯示未來十二個月內及第二年再次有可觀還款到期。在較高利率環境下為此到期階梯再融資可能提高利息成本，而流動比率低於一表示短期義務超過流動資產，需要外部融資或依賴現金流。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 相對於行業中位數，利息覆蓋率偏薄，自由現金流對債務比率亦不高，顯示對盈利不利波動的緩衝空間有限。指示性財務風險狀況為激進，槓桿率處於第四級，現金流覆蓋亦處於第四級，在觸及降級門檻前幾無緩衝。
營運現金流覆蓋債務償付，但股東分派與收購吸收大部分自由現金流，限制去槓桿。到期結構要求在未來十二個月內及第二年再次再融資，而現金餘額雖為正，若無新借款或資產出售，不足以完全抵銷這些短期還款。

overall_credit_view.text: IQVIA 的信用狀況反映其領先的醫療保健情報特許經營業務，擁有穩定營收與穩健現金產生能力，但相對於行業同業，槓桿激進且利息覆蓋偏薄。指示性財務風險狀況為激進，而 Altman Z-score 落在灰色區域，顯示信用風險偏高，但無正式評級含義。
前瞻性判斷：去槓桿取決於 EBITDA 增長與紀律性資本配置，因為回購與收購目前消耗大部分自由現金流。以較高利率為短期到期階梯再融資可能進一步壓縮覆蓋率。重大合約流失或利潤率侵蝕可能將槓桿推向降級門檻，值得密切監控。
